title: villa's self-intersection census of a tifxyz surface (vc_tifxyz_selfcross)

native.vc3d_action: none: VC3D has no menu for it; run villa's binary on a segment folder (--surface SEG -o REPORT): it reports transverse, coplanar and grazing contacts and changes nothing

notes: Listed so the command line and agents see villa's own tools; the registry never runs them. AutoPipeline's qa stage reads its census through the VC3D agent's check_surface (qa.max_selfcross) when the binary is installed; its report is a file to read beside the segment.
